```json
{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "The nature and quality of each improvement goal -- characterizing what each goal aims to improve, how, at what scale, and how well-specified/measurable its target is.",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "improvement_domain", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures the substantive area a goal targets (satisfaction, revenue, cost), a core facet of characterizing the goal."},
    {"name": "primary_action_lever", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Identifies the mechanism/means used to pursue the goal, a coherent 'how' facet."},
    {"name": "target_metric_type", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Classifies how the target is expressed, directly relevant to goal measurability."},
    {"name": "time_horizon", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Adds a temporal facet to goal characterization, useful for prioritization."},
    {"name": "improvement_magnitude_band", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Bands the ambition/size of the target, a meaningful facet of what's worth attention."},
    {"name": "scope_of_change", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Captures organizational reach, a coherent facet of goal significance."},
    {"name": "has_baseline_value", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Flags whether a goal is grounded/measurable -- a quality/rigor facet, highly actionable."},
    {"name": "metric_category_alignment", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Flags internal consistency between metric and category, a data-quality/attention facet."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.85,
  "structure_quality": 0.82,
  "focus_actionability": 0.85,
  "rationale": "The added columns collectively converge on one coherent, data-inferable focus: characterizing improvement goals along interpretable facets (what/how/scope/time/magnitude) plus quality/rigor flags (baseline presence, metric-category alignment). This is not a scattered grab-bag nor a mechanical set (no token counts or bare sentiment); each column extracts a semantically distinct, goal-relevant attribute. The structure is well-differentiated at a useful granularity, mixing categorical facets with quality flags that directly answer 'what's worth attention' (e.g., unbaselined or misaligned goals warrant scrutiny). Minor deductions: the focus is inferred/implicit rather than explicitly proposed, and a couple of facets (time_horizon, magnitude) partly re-encode existing date/target columns, slightly overlapping the original schema. Overall a strong, actionable realization of focus inference."
}
```
